claims.statement: The initial lease term for the Northgate Business Park anchor tenancy is ten years, running from April 1, 2025 to March 31, 2035, with no early termination right for either party during this period.

citations.quote: The initial lease term is ten years, commencing April 1, 2025 and expiring March 31, 2035, with no early termination right in favor of either party during the initial term.
